# The folders and files still allowed to use the containers telar::ds replaces (std::vector,
# std::array, std::optional, std::string, std::map, std::unordered_map, std::function and C
# arrays), one path from the repository root per line; a folder ends in a slash. tbc-lint's
# standard-containers check reports any other use, and an entry whose checked files use none, so
# that it is removed once its folder is migrated.

# telar::ds keeps raw storage in C arrays: Array its values, as std::array does, and String and
# Function their inline bytes. These entries stay.
lib/base/include/telar_base/ds/containers.hpp
lib/base/include/telar_base/ds/values.hpp

# The C interface the GUI's font code shares with Objective-C++: plain C structs, so C arrays.
src/gui/platform/font.h

# FixedString takes a string literal as a template argument, and a literal's type is a C array.
lib/wire/vocabulary/vocabulary-wire.cppm

# Libraries that do not depend on telar's base library, and so cannot use telar::ds.
lib/ebnf/
lib/shell/syntax/
